{{Quote|Born of fire. That YT. A hero's birth if I ever witnessed one.|Bon, describing the construction of the ''Millennium Falcon''|<ref name="Millennium Falcon (novel)">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>}}
'''Bon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] who worked for the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] at [[Orbital Assembly Facility 7/Legends|Orbital Assembly Facility 7]] during [[60 BBY/Legends|60 BBY]]. He was on hand for the fueling and testing mishap during the construction of YT 492727ZED, later known as the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].
